extracted.name: Avocado Salsa
extracted.description: This avocado salsa recipe is so easy, delicious, and fresh! Serve it as a dip with chips, or add it to tacos, burrito bowls, and more.
ingredient_lines: 2 slightly firm ripe avocados (pitted and cubed)
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, place the avocado, mango, cilantro, onion, lime juice, jalapeño, cumin, and salt and gently stir to combine.
Season to taste and serve with tortilla chips.
